rows.scope: Component curves only; no deployment workload or capacity is declared.

rows.excluded: raw construction and correctness checks
rows.name: acts
rows.recipe: Distinct sequential identities over the same named cell, four alternating Actor names; mixed alternates binary and paired structural fixture families. No graph formation or authentication validity is claimed.
rows.timed: validate_history, including returned owned output destruction

rows.excluded: raw construction, burn and policy binding, correctness, per-iteration input clone
rows.name: markers
rows.recipe: Seed-zero burn fixture; initial empty marker then repeated complete accepted singleton r0 and lineage r0,r1, with distinct sequential predecessor positions. Three retained burn records include one consistent alias. Fixture proof equality is not cryptography or chain finality.
rows.timed: validate_marker_history followed by recognize_markers, including returned owned output destruction

rows.excluded: payload and canonical/chunked encoding construction, correctness
rows.name: bytes
rows.recipe: Payload index modulo payload_modulus; canonical byte string or indefinite string with an initial empty chunk and an empty chunk after each definite chunk. Input limit equals wire length; item limit equals payload length plus four. These are experiment limits, never production defaults.
rows.timed: strict or transport decoding and owned output destruction; transport counters include the decoder's allocations

rows.allocation_scope: transport decoder reservation counter only; otherwise unavailable

rows.cpu_scope: waited runner and descendants, including Cargo, correctness and resource-sampling children
rows.lock_identity: Cargo.lock at the public base with the measured implementation patch applied
rows.memory_scope: container cgroup readings; no per-point own peak measurement
